description: The Spanish National Access Point for Traffic and Mobility (Punto de Acceso Nacional de Tráfico y Movilidad), run by the Directorate-General for Traffic on CKAN, is the EU ITS Directive access point for road traffic data. Contents: 39 datasets from 11 publishers, including DGT real-time traffic incidents on the state road network in DATEX II v3.7 (excluding the Basque Country and Catalonia, which publish their own incident feeds, also listed), camera and variable message sign locations and live panel contents, fixed speed camera locations, speed limits as a TN-ITS ROSATTE XML file, slow vehicle positions, connected cones marking roadworks, risk sections for motorcycles and on the Camino de Santiago, low emission zones, municipal parking occupancy, Madrid Calle 30 tunnel incidents, cameras and planned works, provincial road signs for Valencia and Gipuzkoa, and HERE and TomTom safety-related traffic information. Producer: DGT and the listed organisations. Coverage: Spain's road network, national with regional and city feeds. Format and access: DATEX II XML, TN-ITS XML and other formats through dataset pages and direct feed URLs; the CKAN API is closed but pages and feeds are open, some commercial feeds need registration. Licence: CC BY on the DGT DATEX II datasets; others per dataset and the DGT legal notice. Caveats: most feeds are live snapshots without archives. Simulation uses: incident and closure inputs for network resilience and emergency response models, speed limits for routable network building, and camera and sign locations as asset inventories. Related records: the DATEX II standard record (data-datex-ii-standard) describes the exchange format.
